result.title: Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI
result.summary: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Formal Raising，将以优先级排序的道德价值表示成机器可检验的显式性质，并给出一个 C 语言推理框架：候选行动按性质比较筛选、冲突依给定顺序消解、严格规则不可推翻、不确定性显式报告，并用生命、真诚、伤害、隐私等案例演示，另讨论受 PSL 启发的性质层。
AI.relevance_reason: 面向状态与时序需求的显式可检验性质层、以及「欠定即显式报告」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及证据不足时的停止与答案选择提供可核查的约束式思路，但原文并不涉及多模态推理，迁移属推测。
